item.name: Google Integration
item.description:
Google OAuth v2 integration for Google Drive access. The OAuth flow works as follows:
1. Call /connect endpoint with JWT token to get Google OAuth URL
2. User completes OAuth consent in browser
3. Google redirects to /callback endpoint
4. After successful callback, you can use other Google Drive endpoints

request.description: Initiate OAuth connection to Google Drive. Requires JWT authentication. This will redirect to Google's OAuth consent screen.
